lines: ORION ASIC — Tape-out to Production Ramp

primitives.text:
Design: RTL, tape-out and
the A1 respin.

Product engineering:
Fabrication lots, PVT and
the production ramp.

Validation: Bring-up, EVT
and DVT on each silicon
revision.
A1 respin decision is taken from A0 characterization data, not from EVT alone.
